events.title: Galaxy Genesis is the Roblox game that came first
events.detail: A pet-collecting space simulator, designed with Gemini in a running design document. You ignite a star, form planets, sacrifice them for Stardust Pet chrysalises, and rebirth in a supernova. The document is at v0.4 by July 26.

events.title: Galaxy Genesis v0.7 adds saved player data and a hub world
events.detail: Player data is locked to one session at a time, portals lead into a private pocket universe for each player, and the hub world is called 1st and 1st.

events.title: Galaxy Genesis is the first thing put on GitHub
events.detail: The first project ever tracked there, pushed the day before PriceScout. Its last commit lands on PriceScout day and reads "Just trying to get it right this time."

events.title: PriceScout, a work tool built in seven hours
events.detail: Started at 3:45 pm. By 10:45 pm it had a command line and a Google Colab scrape. By 11:45 it broke, because the business day was over and the scraper never knew to roll forward. The lesson was that you still have to know more than the AI. The records bookend the day: repo created at 3:04 pm, Colab notebook at 3:12 pm, last upload at 11:59 pm.

events.title: The Droplet is born
events.detail: A cloud server comes up at 8:26 am Central, with SSH access set up seven minutes later. It becomes the first home for the PriceScout scraper and the other early concepts, before any of it had a proper repo.

events.title: PriceScout gets a database
events.detail: The first price reports come out on August 17. The next evening a commit called "most stable web build with .db initiated" gives it somewhere to keep them.

events.title: Texas Comptroller letter arrives
events.detail: The formal start of 626Labs LLC.

events.title: The first PriceScout demo video
events.detail: Two months after the scrape, the tool gets a screen recording of its own.

events.title: Google AI Essentials, three days before the first line of code
events.detail: Five modules on integrating AI into real work: prompt engineering, evaluating AI tools, and using it responsibly. Google Career Certificates, then straight into building.

events.title: First line of code lands in Project-626Labs-1
events.detail: The canonical 626 Labs repo.

events.title: Firebase enters the dashboard codebase
events.detail: One day after the first commit, Firebase joins the dependencies.

events.title: The dashboard becomes the first Firebase app
events.detail: The first firebase.json sets up hosting, the database, storage, functions and Data Connect config in one commit, under project-626labs.

events.title: A Gemini hackathon opens and Celestia restarts clean
events.detail: A Gemini hackathon opened about a week after the first build. Starting over kept the entry in compliance, and Celestia3 grew from that restart.

events.title: CinePerks Cinema App arrives, Firebase config included
events.detail: Its first commit is also its first firebase.json. The repo is WeSeeYouAtTheMovies.

events.title: Celestia begins, with a tarot mode
events.detail: The original Celestia let an agent build you a custom tarot deck. It made a lot of Christopher Walken decks. Great ones.

events.title: The Lineup ships with a cloud database on day one
A Google Cloud Cybersecurity Certificate lands
events.detail: Compliance lifecycle, cloud backup and one more skill, formal proof next to a year of building it live.

events.title: Cleanup Ranger starts, and the first narrated demo ships
events.detail: The Scripted Demo Automator, with captions and narration, arrives the same day.

events.title: The first generative-video experiment runs on Veo 3.1
events.detail: A demo-video generator inside the dashboard project, built before the ffmpeg and ElevenLabs pipeline.

events.title: Celestia3, Anote-That and Reel-Battles start the same day
events.detail: This is the restart from the December hackathon. Celestia3 runs on Firebase at celestia.626labs.dev.

events.title: The Droplet becomes a deployment target
events.detail: Agent OS is the dashboard agent meant to reach every project from one desktop conversation, keeping the whole system unified. It gains a deploy target manager and server-access tools.

events.title: WriterStudio starts with an audiobook pipeline on paper
events.detail: The pipeline uses ElevenLabs and starts life as documentation. The first two chapters of The Beat That Shook the Void later become its first audiobook.

events.title: The Beat That Shook the Void is the first published fiction
events.detail: A Doctor Who special written in a single evening: first a screenplay, then a short story, posted on Wattpad as eight parts before the night was out. The first two chapters also exist as an audiobook.

events.title: Tag That Line goes up on Firebase for a hackathon
events.detail: Hosting plus an API function, under the project tagthatline.

events.title: Vibe Cartographer gets its first commit
events.detail: It started life as App Project Readiness Plugin, the oldest Vibe repo.

events.title: The earliest dashboard decisions on record set a nine-item roadmap
events.detail: The nine: Media, Docs, Attachments, Types, Writing, The Wire, Portfolio, Universe Bridge, Autopilot.

events.title: 57 Cloud Functions, the MCP server and Universe go live with 43 projects
events.detail: The MCP server runs on the Droplet at port 3626. The functions run on Firebase.

events.title: Architect Galaxy ships with 27 commits and 689 tests
events.detail: Its canvas renderer reaches production on April 15.

events.title: The Vibe plugin family takes shape in one day
events.detail: Vibe Cartographer 1.0.0 and Vibe Doc 0.3.0 ship. The vibe-plugins monorepo, vibe-sec and Sanduhr start.

events.title: 626labs.dev exists with the hub's first commit and its domain
events.detail: 11 commits that day, 1309 since.

events.title: The design system, admin and site renderer arrive in one day
events.detail: Design tokens, the Control Room admin, render-hub.py and the rebuild automation.

events.title: Sanduhr for Claude goes live on the Microsoft Store
events.detail: The first Store app. Microsoft confirms the first publish at 18:23 UTC.

events.title: RBX15 Classic Shirt and Pants Maker goes live on the Store
events.detail: First publish, the day after Sanduhr.

events.title: Right Click to PNG is built and live on the Store in about a day
events.detail: All 33 commits, the shell extension, the WPF settings app, MSIX packaging and CI, landed in one sitting on 04-21, 1:16 pm to 10:17 pm. Partner Center first publish the next day: 20:11 UTC.

events.title: The Bacon Trail widget starts, with the hub's first backend
events.detail: The logPlay Cloud Function, on guestbuzz-cineperks.

events.title: ThesisStudio, BlogStudio and vibe-thesis all start on one day
The background remover ships with a Claude vision loop
events.detail: A classical-CV cutter with six modes, from color-key to matting, plus an agent that looks at each cut and retries until it is clean.

events.title: The first two articles go out on Medium and X
events.detail: Both ran on Medium and X. From Legitimate to Sustainable, a builder guide to vibe-coded software that lasts, went out April 28. The Second User, on how seven Claude Code plugins stabilized the workflow, followed April 29.

events.title: SnapSnip is built in one evening
events.detail: Eight steps, schema, redaction, capture, keyboard hooks, UI and a standalone host, in 2 hours 14 minutes, 9:40 to 11:54 pm. The Store approval that followed took five more days.

events.title: ROROROblox gets its first commit, out of a Cartographer spike
events.detail: 1,147 commits and 35 releases by September 24.

events.title: SnapSnip goes live on the Store
events.detail: First publish. A certification fix shipped the same day.

events.title: RoRoRo goes live on the Store as v1.1.2.0 after a naming rejection
events.detail: The Store rejected the name, so ROROROblox became RORORO. First publish at 22:06 UTC.

events.title: Three Pipelines on Medium
events.detail: A 13-minute read, approved by the Artificial Intelligence publication.

events.title: Anthropic certifies the agent skills work
events.detail: A certificate of completion for Introduction to Agent Skills, the same discipline behind every skill in the estate.

events.title: RoRoRo 1.4.0.0 ships the plugin system and Ur Task
events.detail: The seed of the Ur family.

events.title: RoRoRo article one, the multi-launcher you can recommend on camera
events.detail: On Medium May 17, on X May 19.

events.title: The /announce launch skill is written, and Celestia3's paywall goes live
Local MCP traffic moves off the Droplet onto Firebase
The site gets a management plane in a 42-commit day
events.detail: A health-check script, an agent command line, a portfolio MCP server and an Atom feed. The Field Notes feed and first stories arrive the same day.

events.title: Containment after Mythos gets its spine in one evening
events.detail: A citation pass caught five framing errors.

events.title: Same code, 3x the thinking: first eight hours with Opus 4.8
events.detail: Out on Medium and X the same day.

events.title: Building with the Claude API becomes a certificate too
events.detail: Anthropic Education, credential ec8z294eizmw. Verifiable, alongside a Replit Level 3 Proficient Builder badge and a top-1%-of-Replit-Agent-users ranking, both undated.

events.title: Fable 5 window opens with five plugins promoted and the sprint ratified
events.detail: The first big model hype that made the lab perk up and listen.

events.title: Publishing and design skills go global, and Oscar voice mode arrives
The Dragon's Hoard skill puts an agent on side hustles
events.detail: Print-on-demand designs and other passive-income experiments, run by an agent.

events.title: Celestia3 swaps its GPL engine for an MIT one
events.detail: Swiss Ephemeris is copyleft, which a closed-source app cannot ship. The web version now runs on the MIT-licensed astronomy-engine at about one arcminute, and each page load sheds 12.5 MB. Sub-arcsecond accuracy stays a goal for the native app.

events.title: Celestia3 engine swap proven against Swiss Ephemeris
events.detail: 52 of 52 parity checks pass. A timezone audit adds 1,152 conversion cases and 11 real birth charts checked against published sources, with zero bugs found.

events.title: 626 Mod Launcher goes live as the sixth Store app
events.detail: First publish at 22:27 UTC.

events.title: The first 626 Day arrives with 14 plugins and 6 Store apps
events.detail: 626 Day is now annual.

events.title: Discord server and 6deux6 release bot built in a day
events.detail: The server exists and waits, closed to the public until there is an audience to host. RoRoRo article two runs on X the same day.

events.title: RoRoRo's next move is a connector so Claude can drive the launcher
events.detail: A Pet Sim 99 knowledge base comes with it. This is where Claude playing Roblox starts.

events.title: cut-release makes every release ship with real notes
events.detail: Written after the Discord release feed showed an empty release in public. It refuses to ship a release with an empty or link-only body.

events.title: Version-truth bot and RoRoRo plugin marketplace go live
events.detail: Operating doctrine v1.0.0 lands the same day.

events.title: Model windows and task meditation become skills
events.detail: One playbook for spending a scarce frontier model well, and one ritual for grooming the task backlog against the repo.

events.title: Phosphor Blueprint becomes the first brand treatment
events.detail: Chosen because it was clean and distinctive, and felt like the right slate to start building on.

events.title: The Conundrum Etsy shop and its print-on-demand pipeline go public
tiktok-video-maker turns screenshots into vertical video
events.detail: A slideshow with light effects, optional ElevenLabs voiceover timed to the slides, and a posting script to go with it.

events.title: Celestia3 public copy softened to what the tests prove
events.detail: The about page trades "NASA-JPL-calibrated" for "high-precision, professionally-validated".

events.title: The demo-video skill films a running app and narrates it
events.detail: A scripted capture becomes a two-pass ffmpeg render with cached narration. It stops instead of filming an empty or broken state.

events.title: Sanduhr 3.3.0 ships within hours, ahead of the Fable access change
events.detail: Anthropic was testing Fable with a short window of access, and it was unclear whether it would stay on regular or premium plans. Sanduhr 3.3.0 shipped within hours.

events.title: Theme rotation is built and gated in one day
events.detail: A registry, a checker called theme-doctor, a freeze step and the monthly workflow. 10 commits in a 32-commit day.

events.title: The Etsy connector gets its own Firebase project
events.detail: It first deploys on August 12.

events.title: The ElevenLabs narration pipeline becomes part of the video skill
events.detail: Cloned-voice narration with a tuned baseline (speed 0.93, stability 0.45), timed to the slides and built into tiktok-video-maker.

events.title: RoRoRo Ur MCP 0.1.0 gives Claude thirteen consent-gated tools
events.detail: They drive Roblox. Nothing in this release is specific to a pet simulator. The ore-finder macro follows September 28.

events.title: RoRoRo and 626 Mod Launcher launch videos land in four cuts
events.detail: Each video ends on its tagline and opens with the words that finish it, so the loop completes the sentence.

events.title: Slate Broadsheet joins the queue, and two movie games land on the hub
events.detail: A 43-commit day.

events.title: Brand exports and social cards now follow the active theme
Translation Verification gets its own hosting target under project-626labs
RoRoRo ships six localized trailers and Publishing Console
events.detail: Built in a day. RoRoRo article three, The words were the easy part, goes to X on September 9 and Medium on September 14.

events.title: The cross-pollinator agent starts sweeping projects for shared ideas
events.detail: It reads decisions across the dashboard and briefs four lanes: ports, patterns, collisions and seeds.

events.title: Microsoft Store analytics becomes the twelfth data bot
events.detail: The reach map follows on September 21.

events.title: Baby Watch starts as a Wear OS app for the Pixel Watch
events.detail: A locked, sensory touch playground for babies and toddlers, with a child lock, curved text, animations and sound.

events.title: The name settles as 626Labs LLC, and 33 references get fixed
RoRoRo peaks at 71 installs and 63 acquisitions in one day
propic makes a cutout look like it was standing in the scene
events.detail: It fixes the halo, the focus, the white balance and the contact shadow, so a subject stops looking pasted on.

events.title: A baby app gives the estate its live audio recorder
events.detail: ElevenLabs in a cloned voice kept missing short emotional lines, so all 22 clips were recorded live in about ten minutes instead. The tool then moved into the video skill.

events.title: RoRoRo reaches 167 daily active users, up from 88 a month earlier
Containment for Frontier AI goes out
events.detail: Live on X. On Medium it awaits review by the Artificial Intelligence publication, which has accepted every earlier submission.

events.title: Data Connect retires, and a Pet Sim macro maker starts for the event-day loop
events.detail: The macro-maker repo is built for the Pet Sim event-day loop.
